# First run, as a brand-new user
start app.mihon
sleep 3
shot welcome
tapx Next
shot storage
tap "Select a folder"
sleep 2
shot picker
tap "More options"
tap "New folder"
shot newfolder
type Kurotoon
tapx OK
sleep 2
shot infolder
tap "Use this folder"
tap Allow
sleep 2
shot storage_done
tapx Next
shot permissions
tapx Next
shot guides
tap "Get started"
sleep 3
shot home
tap Library
shot library
tap Updates
shot updates
tap History
shot history
tap Browse
shot browse
tap More
shot more
back
# Add the community extension repo through the standard deep link
view "tachiyomi://add-repo?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keiyoushi/extensions/repo/index.min.json"
sleep 2
shot addrepo_dialog
tap Add
sleep 4
shot after_addrepo
start app.mihon
tap Browse
tap Extensions
sleep 6
shot extensions
tap Search
type MangaDex
sleep 3
shot ext_search
tapx Install
sleep 10
shot install_prompt
tap Install
sleep 15
shot installed
back
back
tap Sources
sleep 3
shot sources
tap MangaDex
sleep 10
shot source_popular
tap Latest
sleep 8
shot source_latest
scrollup
shot source_scrolled
tapxy 270 900
sleep 8
shot manga
scrollup
shot manga_chapters
scrolldown
tap "Add to library"
sleep 3
shot added
tap "Start"
sleep 12
shot reader
tapxy 540 1200
sleep 2
shot reader_menu
tapxy 540 1200
scrollup
scrollup
shot reader_scrolled
back
sleep 2
shot manga_after_read
back
back
tap Library
sleep 2
shot library_after
tap Home
sleep 3
shot home_after
tap History
shot history_after
